name: Night latch
definition: a rim-mounted latch lock on the inside face of a door, with a latch bolt and a key cylinder or snib.
notes: Yale P89 and P77 nightlatches listed; Lock & Key groups night latches as surface-mounted latch locks

name: Rim lock
definition: a box lock fixed to the surface of the door, with a bolt that shoots into a staple or keep.
notes: McMahons lists Yale Essentials Rim Sash Lock; Brass-works filters Rim Deadlock, Rim Sashlock, Rim Latch

name: Euro cylinder
definition: a profile cylinder (the key-operated barrel) that fits a euro-profile mortice lock case.
notes: Euro cylinders sold single, half, double and thumbturn; Yale, Eurospec, BWH models

name: Mortice deadlock
definition: a lock case sunk into the door edge whose bolt is thrown by key only and does not spring back.
notes: Mortice deadlocks listed by lever count (Yale PM552, Union, Strongbolt)

name: Mortice sashlock
definition: a lock case sunk into the door edge with both a spring latch and a key-thrown deadbolt.
notes: Sashlocks with latch and deadbolt; lever count and euro or oval cylinder variants

name: Deadbolt
definition: a stand-alone bolt lock (single or double cylinder, or thumb-turn) fitted through the door with a throw bolt.
notes: Deadbolts sold single cylinder, double cylinder and electronic (Schlage, Kwikset, Tell)

name: Knob or lever lockset
definition: a handle set (knob or lever) that includes a lock, fitted through the door.
notes: Schlage Georgian keyed entry knob filed under Locksets and Door Knobs

name: Multipoint lock
definition: a door lock that throws bolts or hooks into the frame at several points along the door edge.
notes: Avocet multipoint lock listed under Multipoint Lock Systems > UPVC Door Locks

name: Patio door lock
definition: a lock made for a sliding or French (patio) door.
notes: Category of six patio, balcony and tilt-and-slide door locks

name: Door bolt
definition: a sliding bolt fixed to a door to hold it shut.
notes: Barrel, flush, tower and rack bolts sold as door bolts; Squire key and combination bolts

name: Door chain
definition: a short chain that limits how far a door can open.
notes: Door chains category with Yale WS6 (ex Chubb) and ERA 791

name: Window lock
definition: a lock or catch fixed to a window or sash to stop it opening, lockable window handles included.
notes: Key-lockable window restrictor and locking window handles sold as window furniture

name: Open-shackle padlock
definition: a padlock whose shackle is largely exposed above the body.
notes: Steel open-shackle padlock category of 18 products (Abus, Squire, Master Lock, Yale)

name: Closed-shackle padlock
definition: a padlock whose body shrouds most of the shackle to resist cutting.
notes: Steel closed-shackle padlock category of 9 products; shackle enclosed in hardened guard

name: Hasp and staple
definition: a hinged strap and eye fixed to a door and frame, through which a padlock is passed.
notes: Hasp and staple category of 27 products; Abus, Squire, Master Lock, Yale

name: Security chain
definition: a heavy hardened chain made to secure gates, sheds or loose items with a padlock.
notes: ABUS 60mm hardened steel chain, Product Type Security Chain, sold without lock

name: Cable lock
definition: a flexible steel cable with a lock, used to secure loose items.
notes: Cable locks sold in a cycling shop Cables/Chains category (Kryptonite, ABUS, OnGuard)

name: Ground anchor
definition: a heavy anchor fixed in a floor or wall that an item is chained or locked to.
notes: Ground anchor category of 10; Sold Secure Silver to Diamond, bolt-down and wall anchors

name: Safe [金庫]
definition: a steel strongbox with a lock, built to resist forced entry (and often fire), in any installation (freestanding, wall, floor, furniture) and any grade.
notes: Chubbsafes Consul burglary-resistant safe Grade 0/I; Burg-Wachter Pure-Safe wall safe

name: Fire-resistant safe, document box or chest
definition: a container rated against fire only, cabinet or portable lid-opening chest, made to protect papers and media from fire.
notes: Portable fire and water document box, UL72 60 min, key lock (Sentry Fire Chests)

name: Key safe (outdoor key box) [キーボックス]
definition: a small lockable box, often wall-mounted outdoors, holding a door key.
notes: Outdoor wall-mounted code key safes, 27 products, Yale, Master Lock, Abus, Squire

name: Key cabinet
definition: a lockable cabinet fitted with hooks for many keys, sold among security goods.
notes: Wall-mounted lockable key cabinets 30 to 200 keys (Decayeux 486 range)

name: Cash box
definition: a small portable lockable box for money.
notes: Cash boxes category: Master Lock small and medium, Sealey key lock cash box

name: Firearms cabinet or gun safe [Waffenschrank]
definition: a lockable steel cabinet or safe made to store guns.
notes: Waffenschrank comparison: Burg-Wachter, Rottner, Eisenbach; Liberty gun safe series with fire ratings

name: Intruder alarm system
definition: a kit of control panel, sensors and sounder sold and compared as one burglar-alarm system (provisional until attested, K-1).
notes: Swann Wireless Alarm Kit 2: keypad panel, 3 PIR, 3 door sensors, siren sold as one kit

name: Motion sensor
definition: a detector that senses movement in a room and signals or sounds.
notes: PIR motion detector ALC-PIR1 and Altronics mini PIR movement alarm

name: Door and window contact alarm
definition: a magnetic contact that sounds or signals when a door or window opens.
notes: Magnet and transmitter contact sensing door or window opening; Watchguard reed switch set

name: Personal attack alarm
definition: a hand-held device that makes a loud noise to deter an attacker.
notes: Mace 130dB keychain personal alarm, category Personal Alarms

name: Security camera
definition: a fixed camera made to watch and record a place for protection.
notes: Tapo C210 and Wyze Window Cam compared as security cameras

name: Pan-tilt security camera
definition: a security camera with a motor that turns and tilts it.
notes: Tapo TC50 kit titled Solar-Powered Floodlight Pan/Tilt Security Camera Kit, 360 degree coverage

name: Floodlight camera
definition: a security camera built into a floodlight.
notes: Tapo TC50 all-in-one 800-lumen floodlight and camera

name: Video doorbell
definition: a doorbell with a camera that shows and records the caller.
notes: Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 sold as a video doorbell

name: Doorbell and chime
definition: a push button with a sounder that announces a caller, without a camera.
notes: Byron plug-in wireless door chimes, Product Type Door Chimes, push button without camera

name: Door phone
definition: an entry panel with speaker (and screen) linked to an indoor unit for speaking to a caller.
notes: Hikvision DS-KIS702-P two-wire video intercom kit listed as Video Door Phones

name: Camera system kit
definition: a set of cameras and recorder sold and compared as one system (provisional until attested, K-1).
notes: Lorex 4K 8-channel NVR system with 4 dome cameras sold as one kit

name: Letterbox
definition: a freestanding, wall or post mailbox for letters.
notes: Gibraltar Mailsafe lockable wall mount mailbox; Mail Boss Ultimate High Security Locking Mailbox

name: Parcel box
definition: a larger lockable box for receiving deliveries.
notes: Parcel Mailboxes for Package Delivery category; Mail Boss Package Master, Mail Manager

name: Anti-climb spike [忍び返し]
definition: spikes fixed on top of a wall or fence to deter climbing.
notes: Anti Climb Products category: plastic and metal spikes (Prikla, Stegastrip, Razor Point)

name: Security window film
definition: a clear film applied to glass to hold it together when struck.
notes: 3M Scotchshield Safety & Security Window Films hold glass shards in break-ins
